head.h1: Graduation Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Graduation catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person , with a vetted chef who plans the menu, cooks on site and serves your guests. A graduation is one of the few days a family gets to stop and be proud out loud — parents, grandparents, cousins and the friends who studied through every all-nighter, all in one room. Our job is to feed that room beautifully so the host stays part of it instead of stuck behind a stove. Share the date, the guest count and where it is happening, and you get a clear proposal back the same day.

new_paragraphs: What is graduation catering?

Food and service arranged for a graduation celebration: a menu sized to the party, a chef cooking on site or a kitchen delivering ready to serve, and staff who set up, serve and clear away. The mix is built for a mixed-age room and for guests who are moving rather than seated.
How do I cater a graduation party?

Fix the guest count and the hours first, choose the format that matches — finger food and stations for a standing party, buffet for an open house, plated for a seated dinner — then build the menu, agree the per-guest quantities in writing, confirm dietary needs, and plan the table, queue and power at the venue.
How much does graduation catering cost in Dubai?
Graduation catering in Dubai opens at roughly AED 700 per person and moves with your numbers, menu and service level. Send your guest count for an itemised quote.
What is included in graduation catering?
Menu planning, the chef, the service staff, the plating, setup and the cleanup are all covered by one team, so nothing is left on the host.
How far ahead should I book graduation catering in Dubai?

Allow about 72 hours for a standard package, 3 to 5 days for live stations, and 5 to 7 days for a bespoke menu or a large party. Book further ahead across the June and July graduation peak, when dates fill fast.
Can you cater a graduation party at home or a venue?
Yes — we cater graduation parties in villas, apartments, gardens, offices and hired venues across Dubai, adjusting the format to the space and the kitchen access available.
Do you offer halal and vegetarian graduation menus?
Yes — every graduation menu can be built fully halal, and vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free dishes are prepared to order alongside the main spread.
How many guests can you cater a graduation for?
Anything from an intimate family dinner of six to a party of well over one hundred; the menu format and staffing scale to your numbers.
Is there an affordable graduation catering option?
Yes — buffet and drop-off formats are our lowest per-head formats, while plated service with dedicated staff sits at the higher end. We size the plan to your budget.
For graduation catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: How to cater a graduation party, step by step
new_paragraphs: Fix the numbers and the shape of the day. Guest count, the hours the party runs, and whether people will be seated or standing. That decides format before it decides menu.

Pick the format to match. Standing and mingling wants finger food, canapés and stations; a seated family dinner wants plated or family style; an open house that runs for hours wants a buffet that can be refreshed.

Build the menu around a mixed-age room. Something familiar for grandparents, something the graduate's friends will actually eat, and a vegetarian and halal spine so nobody is catered for as an afterthought.
Count the food properly. A standing reception needs more small items than a seated meal needs courses. Ask for the per-guest quantity in writing rather than a menu list alone.
Confirm allergies and dietary needs in writing at booking, not on the day, so the kitchen can plan preparation around them.
Plan the space. Where the food table sits, where guests queue, where the cake is cut, and what kitchen or power access the team has. Gardens in June need shade and chilled courses.
Book early for June and July. Graduation season peaks in those two months across Dubai schools and universities, and the good dates go first.

add_block.new_heading: Graduation catering for families, campuses and corporate milestones
new_paragraphs: Graduation catering works for far more than the classic backyard party at home. A private family dinner for the new graduate calls for a warm plated menu and a celebration cake; a big open-house with the whole extended circle suits a generous graduation buffet that keeps flowing for hours. Schools, universities and training academies use graduation catering for events on campus — canapés and drinks receptions for the ceremony, or a seated lunch for staff and honoured guests. Corporate graduation catering in Dubai covers programme completions, internship class send-offs and professional qualifications, delivered to an office or a hired venue. Whether it is a small graduation party catering brief or a hall of two hundred, the same team scales the menu, the staffing and the pace to match the occasion.

add_block.new_heading: Dietary needs, timing and party logistics
new_paragraphs: Good graduation catering is as much about logistics as it is about the food. Because graduation season peaks in June and July, kitchens and dates fill fast, so the earlier you share your numbers the more choice you keep. We confirm allergies and dietary requirements in writing, label every dish on the day, and separate allergen prep in the kitchen. For an outdoor or garden party we plan for the heat — chilled courses, shaded serving, safe holding temperatures — and for apartments we work neatly within the space and kitchen access you have. If you want to compare formats before deciding, our Dubai catering price guide lays out what buffet, drop-off and plated service each involve.
